The changed file is `bundle-size-baseline.json` — a build-size tracking baseline containing only bundle paths and byte counts. No executable code, no user input, no sinks. This is a passive metadata artifact used by a bundle-size gate; the values are compared numerically, and the path strings never reach shell/filesystem/HTML/log sinks in a security-relevant way.

No security-relevant vulnerabilities are introduced by this diff.
